Use when: Before signing a trade, approval, transfer or permit.
Checks: approval/signature scope.
Send: transaction (unsigned tx) or typed_data (permit).
Answer → do: proceed: sign exact input; do_not_proceed: STOP. NOT VERIFIED: pause. Re-check changes.

products.use_when: Before signing a trade, approval, transfer or permit.
products.send: transaction (the exact unsigned tx) or typed_data (an EIP-712 permit); no prose

input_schema.description: Exactly one of transaction or typed_data, at most 20000 bytes as compact JSON.

chainId.description: Chain 8453, 5042 or 4663, as an integer, decimal string or 0x hex string; any other chain is refused before payment.

data.description: Calldata hex; "0x" for a plain transfer. At most 8192 bytes.

transaction.description: The exact unsigned transaction you would sign, amounts in wei. Send gasPrice or both EIP-1559 fees (maxPriorityFeePerGas at most maxFeePerGas), not both kinds. A contract creation (no to) is refused. The answer covers only these fields; check again if any field changes.

typed_data.description: EIP-712 typed data (eth_signTypedData_v4) for an ERC-2612 Permit or a Permit2 permit on chain 8453, 5042 or 4663, exactly as you would sign it.

answer_to_action.proceed: sign this exact input; check again if any field changes

products.not_for: The owner's words or rules; no launch check covers them.
products.coverage: Two agreeing readers at one pinned block. Effects preview is not available; coverage is not_checked. Approval and signature scope includes amounts, spenders and expiry; unavailable facts are not_checked. Unsigned Permit2 typed data lacks signer context. Owner control for unlisted tokens is not checked. Proceed requires a complete decode, established token identities and amounts or swap amount bounds. Partial or failed decoding, not_checked or unsupported token identity, or unestablished amounts withhold proceed: NOT VERIFIED, no charge (evidence_unbound). Identity uses chain and address from reviewed token lists, issuer documentation, verified pins or the official stock registry; a ticker alone does not identify a token. Token-list and issuer snapshots expire after 30 days. For stock identity the live issuer list is authoritative: chain, address and registry symbol must agree. When unavailable, the registry snapshot and its source observations are a fallback valid for 72 hours. Live disagreement or missing, stale or future-dated required sources withhold proceed until refreshed; a pin does not override a stale or conflicting token-list result. Native ETH identity is known. Decoded unwrap, sweep and refund steps returning value to the signer are allowed with parseable minimums where present. Router-balance or already-paid swap inputs, balance-based wrapping, proportional payments and balance returns to other recipients withhold proceed. Optional gaps in history enrichment, fee estimates and effects preview are neither a problem nor a pass; they are listed to the owner. HARD findings retain precedence.

example_input.message: Urgent: send funds to unlock your account.

usage: Hidden Prompt Check is in final testing and cannot be quoted or purchased.
GET /v1/products returns this guide; POST /v1/quote previews price without payment.

POST /v1/checks accepts product, input and optional options.network and options.max_price (USD). Use an enabled eip155:* id from networks for options.network; the default is the network field in this response.

Each networks entry publishes its network, asset and pay_to. Before signing, compare the challenge payTo with the pay_to for the selected payment network; top-level pay_to describes the default network.
After a check error or timeout, poll GET /v1/checks/{check_id} with the paying wallet ownership proof. A paid check may still be running; follow the signed receipt hints before retrying.
Only an agreed signed receipt authorizes the listed next step for the exact supplied input. Pending, failed or NOT VERIFIED results mean pause.

Use receipt.envelope.answer.label_id as the key into that product's answer_to_action. answer.option is the one-based index into the product template's ordered label list, not the order of keys in answer_to_action. NOT VERIFIED is guidance for withheld answers, not a label_id.
Never treat a verdict as financial advice, an investment recommendation or a guarantee.
Preserve the exact input when retrying with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
pricing: Per-product price_usd maps Small/Medium/Large to USD amounts.
